notes: v4 P0-2 opensource asset library manifest.
Every entry MUST include: id, type, path (relative to this manifest), license, attribution.
Optional: tags (list[str] for semantic match), width/height (int), notes (str).
Licenses accepted at M0: CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA. Others get flagged by license_gate.
M0 ships an empty asset set — the manifest itself is the contract; drop real
CC0 art files (Kenney / OpenGameArt / itch.io) alongside and add an entry to the assets list.
See docs/v4/PRODUCT_v4.md §5.③ for the intended workflow.
